items.title: Ahaziah of Judah
items.charge: Walking in the ways of the house of Ahab, his mother being his counsellor to do wickedly

items.title: Asa in his latter years
items.charge: Hiring the king of Syria against Israel; imprisoning the seer who reproved him; seeking to the physicians and not to the Lord

items.title: Baasha
items.charge: Walking in the way of Jeroboam after being raised up to destroy Jeroboam's house

items.title: Demas
items.charge: Forsaking Paul, having loved this present world

items.title: Israel in the days of the Judges
items.charge: Serving Baalim and Ashtaroth; intermarrying with the Canaanites; every man doing right in his own eyes

items.title: Jehoahaz (Shallum) of Judah
items.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord according to all that his fathers had done

items.title: Joash of Judah
items.charge: Forsaking the Lord after Jehoiada's death; stoning Zechariah in the temple court

items.title: King Solomon
items.charge: Multiplying foreign wives; building high places to their gods

items.title: Lot's wife
items.charge: Looking back toward Sodom against the angel's command

items.title: Rehoboam
items.charge: Forsaking the counsel of the old men; forsaking the law of the Lord

items.title: The churches of Ephesus, Sardis, and Laodicea
items.charge: Leaving the first love; a name to live while dead; lukewarm, and saying, I am rich
